stages.name: adult
stages.anchorMethod: V5 feeding artwork: manually registered stance-center x and foreground supporting toe/hoof sole y from the anatomical planted feet; every idle frame shares one sourceCanvas and stageScale, without per-frame bbox fitting or whole-animal rotation. footprint.supportSelection: Golden toes/webbing RGB r>=100,g>=45,r>g,b<=0.7g, plus one-pixel outline; excludes low feather hem.
footprint.method: Reference frame 0 only: connected support feet in the registered lower-foot region; ellipse center spans the stance extrema and rear/front toe-bottom ground contacts. Same geometry for all idle frames; animal registration and transforms are unchanged.

feedingSource.method: Manual reference-frame mouth/beak ground-contact point in original source coordinates, transformed by the shared anatomical foot registration and stageScale. The independent compound-feed image ground anchor is 3 scene pixels below the contact point; food is absent from animal pixels.
feedingSource.mouthBoundsMethod: A compact common local region of the low mouth/beak near/below the foot plane across the four drawn feeding poses; raised head areas above the foot plane are not exempt. Bounds are kept strictly in front of the explicit foot supportXRange, with a small lower-lip margin, and inverse-mapped to reference source frame 0 for static review.
